KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   B. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   C. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.

2. When practising Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia.

3. When practising Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /b/ na /mb/, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /b/ na /mb/.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /b/ na /mb/.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /b/ na /mb/.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /b/ na /mb/.

   B. Use insults to “practise” Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 2.1.1 Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /b/ na /mb/.

7. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. pana
   B. zito
   C. fupi
